requested_result: Execute bounded workflow-effort comparison and retain a supported simplification or baseline with truthful limits

scope_basis.quote: Improve actual time/context/tool effort needed to deliver equally sound outcomes. Audit current routes and real traces, including operational-efficiency and Prompting comparisons. Challenge unnecessary reads, repeated checks, records, handoffs and mandatory procedure overhead. Compare a focused simplification against the current method on matched representative tasks, preserving outcome quality, uncertainty handling and completion. Returned text bytes alone are not total tokens or elapsed savings; record real available costs and variability. Keep changes focused on workflow orchestration and operational behavior.

required_checks.description: Evidence-grounded bounded retain/reject decision with costs and limits
Matched actual workflow and downstream executions with qualified checks
Protected outcomes, scope, uncertainty and completion preserved
